title: Owned consent-gated generic tracking and temporary inert email pixel
scope: Authorize all generic event/batch principals and resolve durable false-only consent once before request-context collection/dispatch; temporary local inert email pixel with truthful generator. Preserve customer-neutral deterministic core, allowed measurement, existing batch error behavior and necessary consent-only cold records.
non_goals: Not full W05/F05/F10/N06/N11/N12 or privacy acceptance: SDK collection, other ingress/egress/logs, global absent-state/necessary-record lifecycle, configured destination tenant policy, transactional withdrawal, historical records, and D01/D03/D06 remain. Client email/traits/properties are not backend identity assertions; canonical alias enforcement is not downstream CDP merge-policy approval.

Pixel is temporary local fail-closed containment, not permanent feature removal or accepted email-open measurement. Generated identifier URLs, hosting logs, existing email/docs examples and lifecycle remain outside collection-route fix. No query credentials or recipient-to-principal minting; re-enablement/design/customer-surface decisions require applicable authority.

Only five declared route/fixture/API files plus worker proof. No shared helper/DO/SessionManager/dispatcher/scoring/SDK/build/infrastructure changes, new harness or RPC, whole-history reruns, staging/commit/push/deploy/cloud/credentials/customer-data/destructive/unrelated operations. Root alone owns governance.

criteria.description: Actual /track/event and /track/batch require existing shopper capability before broad catches; preserve terminal access errors. Parse whole request/batch and assert every populated user.userId/user.anonymousId/recipientId alias and context.sessionId against canonical owned subject/SID before consent or any dispatch. Reject conflicting/empty supplied aliases and later invalid batch entries atomically. Enriched user anonymousId remains canonical, no getUserContext random alias. Resolve consent once per batch using strict owned session read plus same-snapshot restrictConsent, or one existing signed DO GET /consent or POST /consent/refusal. All four stored switches on both hosts without cookies: tracking=false produces explicit skipped/refused non-dispatched receipt and no context/dispatcher/fetch/retry/event queue/AE; tracking=true preserves permitted measurement regardless of personalization switch. Configured positive controls exercise actual failing fetch plus retry/event queue, not disabled/mock-only dispatch.

Accept optional strict boolean consent:{tracking?,personalization?} on single event, batch and each event; any false hint anywhere in same-owner batch or cookies restricts whole batch and persists before acknowledgement. True cannot upgrade; explicit preferences can. Consent hints are not event payload. Cold route makes no behavioral/profile/visit/user-pointer records, only necessary refusal. Missing/malformed/failed owned state or DO envelope, required write failure, wrong owner/forward/recognized state deny with no fanout. Pixel GET/HEAD retains 43-byte GIF/cache contract while performing no decode/context/identity/state/dispatcher/queue/fetch/AE for any valid/forged/invalid/cookie/query/capability input. Generator retains shape but explicitly trackingEnabled:false with fixed reason; focused API note documents inactive containment and owned tracking contract. Preserve allowed batch per-event error handling and fixed labels; existing unrelated telemetry assertions stay intact.

Independent actual original/final source, baseline, existing fixture assertions and full worker proof review; exact K1 rerun, app noEmit/scoped diff inspected, relevant local import graph/artifact pins matched. Separate lead accepts only bounded local containment, retains W05.04 exact acceptance historically before boundary-fixture overlap and all failures/limitations/next action.
